t: The Erbauer 1/4" hex shank impact screwdriver bit set is a comprehensive collection of heavy-duty bits designed for use with impact drivers. These S2 steel blades feature precision tips to ensure a secure fit into fasteners, significantly reducing stripping and cam-out during high torque applications. The robust construction allows each bit to withstand the demanding output of impact drivers, making them ideal for continuous use on construction sites or in busy workshops. A black-oxide coating provides enhanced durability, and laser-etched markings on each piece allow for quick identification of the mixed tip types and sizes. This 113-piece set offers long life and reliable performance for a variety of fastening tasks.
b: Suitable for Power Screwdrivers with Impact Mode
Precision Tip Fit Reduces Stripping & Cam-Out
Highly Visible Laser-Etched Markings for Quick Identification
Includes Bit Holder & Quick Change Chuck
